GERMAN — TERMLY EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: GERMAN
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. “Guten Tag” means: (1 mark)
   A. Please
   B. Good day / hello
   C. Good night
   D. Thank you

2. When practising Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Fluency Critical listening Tourist destinations and attractions.

3. When practising Listening comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening comprehension.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening comprehension.

4. When practising Reading comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading comprehension.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Reading comprehension.

5. When practising Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Listening for Information ● biased listening ● listening for comprehension ● con.

6. When practising Extensive reading Scanning, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Extensive reading Scanning.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Extensive reading Scanning.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Extensive reading Scanning.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Extensive reading Scanning.

7. When practising Intensive reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive reading.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive reading.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Intensive reading.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Intensive reading.

8. When practising Listening for details Conversational skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for details Conversational skills.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for details Conversational skills.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Listening for details Conversational skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for details Conversational skills.

9. When practising Reading for comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for comprehension.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for comprehension.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Reading for comprehension.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading for comprehension.

10. When practising Intensive Reading Skimming, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Intensive Reading Skimming.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Intensive Reading Skimming.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Intensive Reading Skimming.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Intensive Reading Skimming.

11. When practising Public speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Public speaking.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Public speaking.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Public speaking.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Public speaking.

12. German for “school” is: (1 mark)
   A. Wasser
   B. Buch
   C. Haus
   D. Schule

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Reading for comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Intensive reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Reading comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Reading Comprehension Extensive reading ● World currencies, ● Banking services ● and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Descriptive Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Expository writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
